area_tolerance_pct.note: Allowed area difference: the larger of 10% of the title area and 0.1 ha (team document)

area_tolerance_min_ha.note: As above: lower bound of 0.1 ha

area_fail_over_pct.note: More than 50% over the title area fails outright (team document)

expiry_warn_days.note: Warn when fewer than 90 days remain before expiry (team document)

name_similarity_min.note: A name similarity of at least 0.85 counts as the same person (team document)

confidence_min.note: A read confidence below 0.7 needs the user to confirm (team document)

point_max_ha.note: EUDR: plots under 4 ha may be given as a single point; sources differ on exactly 4 ha, so it is treated conservatively as a polygon

smallholder_max_ha.note: MPOB smallholder licence: up to 100 acres (40.46 ha)
